abort.already_configured: Those hacks are already set up for this.
abort.no_dreame: Set up the Dreame Vacuum integration first.

probably_fixed.title: Hack probably not needed: Dreame cleaning mode
probably_fixed.description:
Dreame Vacuum {version} has run for a week without dropping "mopping after sweeping" from its cleaning-mode options (last seen on {bug_version}).

Switch automations from "Cleaning mode (fixed)" back to Dreame's own cleaning-mode select, then delete the "{title}" entry under Alex's Hacks.

confirm.title: Remove {room}?
confirm.description:
Room {room_id} ("{room}") is no longer on {vacuum}'s map, so {entity_id} is unavailable and anything that picks it (e.g. the vacuum-then-mop action) won't clean it.

If the room was merged, split or redrawn, pick the new room(s) wherever this one was used. Submit to remove {entity_id}. If you'd rather wait, close this: the repair clears itself if the room comes back.

drying_wont_stop.title: Mop drying won't stop: {title}
drying_wont_stop.description:
Drying should have stopped (Allow drying is off, or the mop has had its full drying time), but the robot still reports drying after several tries. Alex's Hacks keeps trying every couple of minutes.

Check the robot in the Dreame app (stop drying there if need be). This repair clears itself once drying stops.

confirm.title: Turn off the robot's auto-drying
confirm.description:
The robot's own auto-drying is on, so it dries the mop by itself after every wash and Alex's Hacks has stopped controlling drying (Allow drying does nothing until it's off).

Submit to turn auto-drying off on the robot; Alex's Hacks then takes over drying straight away. (Or turn it off yourself with the robot's Auto drying switch or in the Dreame app.)

abort.not_connected: The robot isn't connected right now. Try again later, or turn auto-drying off in the Dreame app.
abort.failed: The robot didn't accept that (see the log). Turn auto-drying off with the robot's Auto drying switch or in the Dreame app.

dreame_vacuum_then_mop.name: Vacuum then mop
dreame_vacuum_then_mop.description: Vacuums the rooms, waits until the robot has completely finished (not just a recharge, mop wash or auto-empty), then mops them. Turns CleanGenius off and customized cleaning on while it runs, then puts both back. Waits until the whole clean is done.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: In cleaning order, each with its own settings. Blank settings: standard suction, wetness 16, one pass. "Don't vacuum" or wetness 0 skips a phase for that room.

max_duration.name: Longest phase
max_duration.description: Give up (with an error) if a phase takes longer than this.

notify_person.name: Notify person
notify_person.description: Sends a notification to every phone the person is signed in to with the companion app, with optional notification data (buttons, links, images, channels…), the same as for a phone's own notify action.

data.name: Data
data.description: Companion app notification data, e.g. actions (buttons), clickAction, image, channel.
